_comment: Matches GoReleaser's *real, verified* scoop output shape (dist/scoop/porthole.json after `goreleaser release --snapshot --clean`) — bin lives per-architecture as an array, not as a shared top-level string, which an earlier hand-written version of this file got wrong. checkver/autoupdate below are a deliberate addition beyond GoReleaser's raw output (it doesn't generate them) — recommended by Scoop's own docs so the bucket can self-update between releases without a manual PKGBUILD-style bump each time. Not registered in any bucket; needs every {{ PLACEHOLDER }} filled in from a real release.
description: A port kill switch and service viewer for your terminal.
